intro: Zamja is a Darkspear troll cooking trainer found working in the bustling corridor of the Drag in Orgrimmar. Known for her steady hand with a meat cleaver, she instructs Horde adventurers in preparing hearty meals from the beasts of Kalimdor.

p: Stationed within the winding canyon path of the Drag, Zamja spends her days breaking down cuts of meat and teaching hungry Horde travelers how to sustain themselves. Practical cooking is a vital survival skill in the rugged terrain of Durotar and the Barrens, and Zamja ensures that anyone willing to hold a skillet learns the basics of turning raw game into wholesome rations. For cooks who have mastered basic recipes and seek further training, she directs them south toward Gadgetzan.
